fixture_note: Scenario 1: select the highest-leverage next action from competing priorities. Expected outcome ALLOW with a recommendation, one minor contradiction detected but not blocking, and execution NOT_AUTHORIZED because no action was requested.

intake.problem_statement: Three candidate work items compete for the next build slot across the Operator Intelligence and Cognitive Routing Layer repositories, and only one can be started this week.

options.label: Complete the Cognitive Routing Layer v0.1 vertical slice
options.mechanism: Implement the deterministic router, operator contract enforcement, and decision receipt against the locked policy so the pipeline runs end to end.
options.tradeoff: Defers commercial packaging work by at least one week.

options.label: Package the assessment service for sale
options.mechanism: Assemble buyer-facing collateral, pricing tiers, and a proposal template from existing assessment content.
options.tradeoff: Commits to a commercial claim before any buyer evidence exists.

options.label: Reconcile repository documentation
options.mechanism: Audit every README and architecture note against the shipped behaviour and correct the drift.
options.tradeoff: Consumes the slot on maintenance rather than on new capability.

claims.statement: Three materially distinct mechanisms are available: build capability, package existing capability, or repair the record of capability.

defects.statement: Packaging assumes demand that no evidence in this run measures.
defects.remediation: Collect two buyer conversations with recorded willingness to pay before packaging.

defects.statement: The extent of documentation drift is asserted rather than measured, so the work cannot be sized.
defects.remediation: Run a drift diff across README and architecture files and count the divergences.

defects.statement: Prerequisites being present does not establish that the slice fits inside one build slot.
defects.remediation: Timebox the slice and record actual elapsed effort against the estimate.

claims.statement: Packaging rests on an unmeasured demand assumption.
An unattributed note suggests the slice may overrun its slot, but the source is anecdotal and unverified.

assumptions: Downstream systems adopt the receipt format without renegotiation.

effects.statement: Once receipts exist, the leverage ranking can cite reasoning coverage rather than asserting it, which changes what the adjacent subsystem is able to claim.
effects.follows_from: The vertical slice emits decision receipts.

effects.statement: Packaging before demand evidence exists creates a public claim that later evidence may contradict, which is expensive to retract.
Documentation repaired before behaviour stabilises drifts again within one release, consuming the slot twice.
effects.follows_from: Documentation is reconciled against current behaviour.

claims.statement: Building the slice first is what makes the downstream ranking defensible, so its second-order value exceeds its direct output.
Reconciling documentation against unstable behaviour repeats the work within one release.
